annotations.text:
THE HAPPY PATH IS TWO TAPS.

Tap the tag → the record comes up from the device's own copy of last year's inspection, read-only, so the tech is verifying he has the right part rather than retyping it. Every check is already Pass. He looks at the harness, sees the record agrees, taps Pass & Next.

Nothing is typed. Nothing is a form field. The identity block is deliberately read-only with a small Edit — if it were inputs, a stray touch would edit last year's data on a part he is only confirming.

A DEFECTIVE ITEM IS THE ONLY THING THAT COSTS MORE TAPS.

Tapping Fail on any one check flips the whole item to FAIL — the tech never sets the overall result — and the button turns into "Why?". Reason and photo are both required, and the database enforces the same rule, so a device that skips them is refused.

Not on file yet is the uncommon path: a tag with no record. It is the only screen with input fields, and it says plainly that next year it will come up filled in.

Changed from the last pass: form-first direction, checks reduced to one 44px row each so six fit without scrolling, everything defaulted to Pass, and the identity block turned from inputs into a verified record.

Sample data throughout. Check wording is placeholder — the real set comes from the model's checklist.
